proposal.hypothesis: The four distinct catalog programs were valid. The rsqrt variant measured 0.001009684 s; rsqrt with factor-four unrolling measured 0.001009364 s, a difference small relative to the recorded sample spread, while split ranges plus rsqrt measured 0.001025174 s. This experiment keeps the original traversal, self-exclusion, and arithmetic, but explicitly caches the target position and mass scalars. It tests whether those loop-invariant values otherwise incur repeated loads; compiler hoisting may already make this a no-op, and register effects could offset any benefit.

retained: Cache the target position and mass in four scalar locals before the source loop and use them in each interaction.
